title: brief check refuses missing npm scripts
body:
Outcome: `krn brief check` refuses a brief whose Steps or checks name `npm run <script>` absent from the worktree's package.json (exit 65, naming the script).
Evidence: #210 brief named `npm run typecheck` (no such script); worker reported done with a failing check, exit 4, and the lead restarted the worker stage with --worker none (.krn/runs/lead/landing/slice-worker.log).
Proof: an observer runs brief check on a brief naming a missing npm script and expects exit 65; an existing script passes.
